title: HostEventAttendanceReportDocument
description: Server-maintained manager read view of one event's attendance report for Host close-out: the roster report exactly as getEventAttendanceReport returns it, as of serverTime. Written by triggers on eventAttendees (status, check-in and revision changes), eventAttendanceDispositions (no-shows recorded or cleared) and events (cancelled, moved or deleted); deleted when the event is gone or its roster is over the report limit. Never identity, permission or mutation authority: no-shows are recorded through recordEventNoShow.
x-owner: Host read model projector (hostReadModels attendance report view triggers)
